vibe_rationale: Community-loved dry-season arts festival with strong First Nations programming, but broad, heavily sponsored and mainstream-leaning.
fit_notes: Broad Top End arts audience with family events mixed in and no published age data, so adult weight and wellness adjacency are both modest. The partnerships page and 57 listed partners make the route open, but resource-company sponsors set a high bar and the artistic director change after 2026 may reset conversations.
